name: Nordilloma
summary: Support for normal cell and immune function

hero.subtitle: Targeted nutritional support for people with HPV infection and during follow-up
hero.intro: Nordilloma combines EGCG, hyaluronic acid, folic acid and vitamin B12 in a formula designed to support normal immune function, cellular processes and epithelial health.
hero.doseNote: Do not take on an empty stomach.

audience.heading: A clearly defined role, without unnecessary complexity
audience.body: Designed for adults with a positive HPV result, including people with persistent infection or mild epithelial changes that are being monitored. Regular medical follow-up remains an essential part of HPV care.

items.title: Immune support
items.body: Vitamin B12 and folate contribute to normal immune function.

items.title: Normal cellular processes
items.body: Vitamin B12 and folate support normal cell division, while EGCG is being studied for effects on cellular processes relevant to HPV.

items.title: Epithelial support
items.body: Hyaluronic acid is a natural component of connective and epithelial tissue and is included to support tissue hydration and integrity.

formula.heading: Different roles, one clear purpose
formula.intro: HPV infection is very common and clears spontaneously in most people. When it persists, regular follow-up becomes especially important. Nordilloma is designed as complementary nutritional support through four ingredients with distinct roles: antioxidant, immune, nutritional and epithelial support.
formula.calloutBody: The formula combines four ingredients with distinct roles rather than relying on a single component. EGCG provides a polyphenol and antioxidant base, folate and vitamin B12 support immune function and cell division, while hyaluronic acid adds a component focused on epithelial tissue.

ingredients.heading: Composition and the role of each ingredient

items.name: EGCG
items.role: A 95% standardized green tea extract. EGCG is being studied in HPV-positive cells, cellular proliferation and antiviral response.

items.name: Hijaluronska kiselina
items.role: A natural component of the extracellular matrix, included to support hydration and maintenance of normal epithelial structure.

items.name: Vitamin B12
items.role: Contributes to normal immune function and plays a role in cell division.

items.name: Folna kiselina
items.role: Contributes to normal immune function, cell division, amino acid synthesis and normal blood formation.

useCases.heading: Practical situations for use
items: With a positive HPV result alongside regular follow-up
With persistent HPV as complementary nutritional support
With mild cervical changes (LSIL/CIN1) when monitoring has been chosen by the clinician
After local treatment of HPV-related changes, with continued follow-up

notes.heading: Safe and responsible use
notes.warnings: Do not exceed the recommended daily dose or 300 mg of EGCG per day, and do not use other green tea products on the same day. Not intended for pregnant or breastfeeding women or anyone under 18. Nordilloma does not replace HPV vaccination, cervical screening, HPV testing, colposcopy or any examination or treatment recommended by a clinician.
notes.legalNote: Food supplements are not a substitute for a varied and balanced diet and a healthy lifestyle. Keep out of the reach of small children.

purpose: NORDILLOMA je dodatak ishrani na bazi ekstrakta lista zelenog čaja, hijaluronske kiseline, vitamina B12 i folne kiseline.
